components.name: twenty_turn_process_restart
components.description: Twenty append-only turns add distinct originals. The seed process exits after turn nine; two separate worker processes reopen both persistent stores, synchronize each remaining turn, preserve all earlier replacement bytes and markers, and exactly recover every referenced original.
